description: Reopen r-sort-3b-lu (English UK, LANGID 0x0809) read-only. Reads the IDs that survived the one-INSERT-per-row loads into the unique-indexed UQ (K) and UQD (K DESC); walks UX_K forward and backward and UX_KD forward and backward; enumerates every index of T, UQ and UQD (Name, Primary, Unique, Foreign, Required, IgnoreNulls, DistinctCount, field names and attributes). Asks which values the unique index treats as equal under this locale (case, accent, expansion, spacing, Null and empty), which row of each class survives, and whether a descending unique index selects the same classes.
retentionNote: Designed r-sort-3b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
